record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: What is the maximal possible dimension of the tangent space at a point of Hilb_d(A^3)?

evidence.quote: Problem XXIV ([17]). Which is the maximal tangent space dimension to a point of Hilbd(A^3)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of length $d$ in the affine space $\mathbb{A}^3_k$. A closed point of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ corresponds to an ideal $I \subset k[x,y,z]$ such that $\dim_k k[x,y,z]/I = d$, and the Zariski tangent space at such a point is canonically identified with $\mathrm{Hom}_{k[x,y,z]}(I, k[x,y,z]/I)$.

Determine, as a function of $d$, the maximum value of
$$\dim_k \mathrm{Hom}_{k[x,y,z]}(I, k[x,y,z]/I)$$
as $I$ ranges over all ideals defining a closed point of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$. Equivalently, find the maximal possible dimension of the Zariski tangent space at a point of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is connected to a long-standing conjecture of Briançon–Iarrobino on the most singular points of the Hilbert scheme of points. Recent work (2023–2025) provides conjectural criteria for the maximum tangent space dimension in three dimensions, reducing it to a problem in convex geometry, and exhibits explicit examples (e.g. in lengths 8 and 39) that disprove some earlier guesses. The maximum tangent space dimension at a point of Hilb_d(A^3) is not known in general and the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Conjectural criteria for the most singular points of the Hilbert schemes of points
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectural necessary and sufficient conditions for a point of the Hilbert scheme of points to have maximum tangent space dimension; sufficient condition claimed in 3D; reduces to a convex geometry problem.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of the maximum tangent space dimension at a point of Hilb_d(A^3) is still treated as conjectural/open, related to the Briançon–Iarrobino conjecture.

status_evidence.title: A monotonicity conjecture for the local maximal singularity of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work formulating further conjectures about the local maximal singularity of Hilbert schemes of points.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research indicates the question remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the tangent space to the Hilbert scheme of points in P3
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounds and examples for tangent space dimensions at points of Hilbert schemes of points in three-dimensional space.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results and bounds exist but no closed formula for the maximum is established.
